gate: M10/1 Active; reusable decoder slice, no full-gate acceptance
deliverable: Golden Video can demux local files and decode H.264/H.265/ProRes through pinned FFmpeg libraries while retaining original presentation timestamps, software planes and color metadata. Delayed frames drain at clean EOF; errors poison the owner until reopen. MapGyver Video is not yet wired or playable.
ownership: golden_video::decode owns reusable file/codec/frame lifetime for a caller's worker. The future app-owned Video transport, typed Files and commands project requests into this boundary. No FFmpeg calls on the engine thread, new polling or GPU-to-CPU readback is introduced.

dependencies.binding: ffmpeg-next =9.0.0, optional feature ffmpeg, format only; ffmpeg-sys-next9.0.1 pinned by Cargo.lock
dependencies.ffmpeg: n9.0.2-48-gd4070a14ce-20261108, shared Windows x64 LGPL3 build with supplied MSVC import libraries
dependencies.preparation: with-ffmpeg.ps1 checks the exact archive digest/size, prepares only target/ffmpeg-pinned and restores process-local environment after Cargo. Production decode does not invoke ffmpeg.exe. Final DLL/notices/corresponding-source packaging remains M10/4.
dependencies.lock_updates: The new FFI dependency requires cc>=1.6 and bindgen0.73; lock updates cc/find-msvc-tools and adds the exact FFI, binding, bindgen, num_cpus and vcpkg packages. Existing bindgen0.72 remains separately resolved.

software.binding_prerequisite: Explicit feature compile/no-run passed before decode execution, resolving Windows import-library/header/libclang/FFmpeg9 ABI uncertainty.
software.strict: Same helper: clippy --locked -p golden_video --lib --tests --no-default-features --features ffmpeg -- -D warnings; exit0.
software.feature_disabled: cargo test --locked -p golden_video --lib --no-default-features --quiet:162 passed,0 failed, exit0; FFmpeg remains optional.
software.contracts: Five decoder cases cover invalid limits/missing file; eighteen common-codec frames with exact24/25/30000-over1001 timing, independent grey pixel levels, explicit BT709, real B-frame drain and retained frames after decoder destruction; dimension/packet/work admission; malformed-to-replaced file reopen; untimed elementary streams rejected without invented frame-rate timestamps. Failed owners consistently require reopen.
software.unchanged_scope: No wire protocol, app UI, authored product policy or native runtime code changes. Existing app checks retain their earlier scope; no native experiment is required for this CPU/library slice.

fixtures.recipe: Adjacent generate-fixtures.ps1; synthetic64x48 six-frame luma sequence32+24*N. Encoder used for fixture generation only: Gyan FFmpeg9.0.1 Essentials. H.264 and HEVC contain actual B frames; ProRes is yuv422p10le. Decoder uses the independently pinned library build.

corrected_validation: The first preparation helper declared advanced PowerShell remaining arguments, causing Cargo -p to be consumed as -PipelineVariable. Replaced that parser with verbatim $args; the documented command now runs the named package and its complete167-test suite. No app/runtime workaround or test skip was added.
remaining: M10/1 still needs real per-media transport/per-channel File Parameters, exact seek/step/rate/loop/shorter-channel hold, shared References, worker integration and all UI/script/command/callback/snippet/history/project parity. GPU-resident D3D11 hardware frames, HAP compressed texture playback, file/device recovery, bounded queues and full packaging/performance remain required in the owning first-pass gates. Do not count software decode as hardware playback or common-codec app acceptance.
